name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno-based mineral exploration and royalty company focused on the gold-mining jurisdiction of Nevada, with additional property interests in Idaho. The company combines direct property exploration with the acquisition of royalty interests across projects including the Lazy Claims, Loman, Agai-Pah, and Swales properties in Nevada and the Belshazzar property in Boise County, Idaho. It trades on the OTCQX Best Market and operates as an exploration-stage company with a diversified precious metals asset model.
